answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the quill of free entry disappears, the trellis of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the copper case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Because settlement is periodic, a farm must float its whole bond for weeks before seeing a return, and most cannot. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
